name: Guest
overview: Scripture highlights the significance of hospitality and discernment in the treatment of guests. Abraham's eager reception of unexpected visitors, exemplified by his running to meet the three men and bowing before them, models a gracious and humble welcome. At the same time, Proverbs offers cautionary guidance on engaging with those who may not have sincere intentions, warning believers to be prudent and guarded in their interactions, especially when dining with rulers or those who might deceive with outward generosity. Together, these passages emphasize both the honor due to guests and the wisdom required in their conduct.
